notes:
You can call or text the National Maternal Mental Health Hotline at 1-833-TLC-MAMA (1-833-852-6262). It offers free, confidential, 24/7 support in English and Spanish for pregnant and postpartum people. Its counselors give emotional support, information, and referrals to local resources.

Postpartum Support International has an online provider directory. You can use it to find qualified perinatal mental health professionals and groups in the United States and Canada. Listed providers are in good standing with state standards and have completed specialized perinatal mental health training.

Washington also has Perinatal Support Washington, a statewide non-profit focused on perinatal mental health. Its toll-free Warm Line has offered peer support to parents since 1991. Its directory lets you search for resources in your area.
